title: Payment required before download
body: An applicable fee must be confirmed before this file can be opened.

sections.title: Download unavailable
sections.body: The payment is not confirmed. Cashiering handles payment for this request.

annotation: Verified owner of an unpaid fee-required request only. No filename, preview or private file content shown. Unauthorized viewer uses G10.4 instead, with no payment explanation. This design does not create a charge, confirm payment or download a file.

title: This time is no longer available
body: Choose another available time to continue booking.

sections.title: Time unavailable
sections.body: The selected time could not be booked.

annotation: First-booking conflict. No current appointment exists and no original-booking-unchanged claim or reschedule action appears. Preserve actual destination/date selection on return. Do not invent capacity or deadlines.

title: No available times
body: Try another date or ask the office about availability.
annotation: First-booking empty availability. No existing booking or Keep current appointment action. Date field is a static design representation until implementation; return preserves actual consultation destination.

title: Sending office reply…
body: Your reply stays visible while it is being sent.
annotation: Staff-scoped pending-send state. Preserve actual pending reply, disable duplicate Send and wait for authoritative result. Static Figma field does not capture edits. Back does not cancel or discard an in-flight operation; on failure use G14.staff-failed. No student navigation.

title: Reply wasn't sent

sections.title: Not sent
sections.body: Check the reply and try again.

annotation: Staff role and authorized thread remain unchanged. Preserve actual recoverable unsent text. If the send result is uncertain, reconcile before retry to avoid duplicates. No persistent draft, typing, presence or read-receipt feature is implied.

title: Review assignment
body: Check the recipient before changing this inquiry's assignment.

sections.title: Assignment review
sections.body: No actual recipient is selected in this design.

sections.title: Recipient required
sections.body: Choose a recipient you are authorized to assign this inquiry to.

annotation: Design-only review structure. Unknown values remain em dashes, with no invented name. Confirm stays disabled until a real authorized recipient is selected and reviewed. Current owner remains until server confirmation; actual success returns to the staff thread with confirmed assignment.

title: Assignment wasn't changed
body: The current owner is unchanged. Review the recipient and try again.

sections.title: Assignment
sections.body: No actual assignment is loaded in this design.

sections.title: Change not confirmed
sections.body: Keep the current assignment until the change is confirmed.

annotation: Preserve actual current owner and requested recipient on recoverable failure. This example has no actual recipient, so Retry is disabled. Enable a safe retry only after a valid authorized recipient exists; reconcile an uncertain result first. No ownership change is claimed.
